findings.title: boulder.json PR count (33, #29-61) contradicts compliance report (35, #29-#63), its own PR table (ends #61), and git history (#62-#76 merged after boulder was last written)
findings.description: boulder.json:31 notes claim '33 PRs merged (#29-61)'. docs/p5_9-compliance-report.md:9 claims '35 PRs total (#29-#63) are merged to main across this session'. The report's own PR ledger ends at row '#61' (line 68) with no rows for #62/#63. git log on main shows merge commits 4d9944d (#62), 1c562c6 (#63), e5f7ddd (#64) through cc144dc (#76) landed AFTER boulder.json's last touch (commit 6a13336, 'Oracle VERIFIED iteration 14 into all artifacts'). Three mutually inconsistent merge-scope answers exist across two tracked verification artifacts.
findings.root_cause: boulder.json session notes and the compliance report were authored at different Oracle iterations (12-14) and never reconciled; the report narrative was bumped to '#29-#63' while its table still stops at #61, and boulder froze at #61/33.
findings.impact: PR-level claims in shipped-verification artifacts cannot be reconciled: an auditor asking 'what did the self-host milestone merge' gets 33 (#29-61) from boulder, 35 (#29-#63) from the report narrative, 31 listed rows ending #61 from the report table, and 48 merged PRs (#29-#76) from git. Undermines trust in the milestone-closure claim and in boulder.json as the authoritative session state.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate both artifacts from one source of truth in a single pass: derive the PR ledger from 'git log --merges main' at a pinned commit, stamp both boulder.json notes and the report with 'ledger verified at <sha>', and add the missing #62/#63 rows (4d9944d 'verification-artifact-integrity-2', 1c562c6 'oracle-verified-landing') to the report table.

fix_examples.before: boulder.json: "notes": "self-host-completion-roadmap: 33 PRs merged (#29-61). ..." / p5_9-compliance-report.md:9: "35 PRs total (#29-#63) are merged to main"
fix_examples.after: boulder.json: "notes": "self-host-completion-roadmap: 35 PRs merged (#29-63) at time of milestone closure (ledger frozen at 1c562c6); #64+ belong to follow-up waves. ..." / p5_9:9: "35 PRs total (#29-#63) merged; full ledger in table below, verified at commit 1c562c6" + two new table rows for #62/#63

findings.fix_guide: Run: git log --oneline --merges main | Select-String '\(#[0-9]+\)' to list all merge commits; confirm the milestone boundary is 1c562c6 (#63); update boulder.json notes (count + range + boundary sha) and insert the #62/#63 rows into docs/p5_9-compliance-report.md between lines 67-68; commit as one docs change.

effort_estimate.breakdown: git ledger extraction 10min; boulder.json edit 10min; report table edit + narrative sync 15min; self-review 10min

findings.title: 73 evidence files are git-TRACKED while both AGENTS.md files assert evidence is gitignored and 'never committed'
findings.description: .sisyphus/AGENTS.md:74-75 and root AGENTS.md NOTES state '.sisyphus/evidence/ is gitignored ... Verification artifacts live locally but are never committed'. Reality: 'git ls-files .sisyphus/evidence' returns 73 tracked files (task-121b through task-141, parity-audit.md/json, final-qa/, baseline-v1.25.json, audit-remediation-tracker.md). .gitignore:20 ignores the directory but lines 22 and 43 negate only MANIFEST.json and extensions-counter.json; 'git check-ignore -v' confirms the rule matches new files. The 71 other tracked files predate the ignore rule (introduced around commit 51c36fa, PR #27) and git never untracks already-committed files.
findings.root_cause: The evidence-ignore rule was added mid-project (v1.25-era) without 'git rm --cached' on existing evidence, and both AGENTS.md files were written describing the intended posture rather than the actual repository state.
findings.impact: The documented audit posture is false in the Convenient direction: evidence supporting shipped claims IS versioned (good for traceability), but two knowledge-base files assert otherwise. An auditor or agent trusting AGENTS.md would wrongly conclude shipped-claims evidence is unverifiable from history; conversely the 2 negation entries show intent to version evidence selectively while 71 files are grandfathered in with no recorded decision. Posture note: risk is documentation-integrity, not missing evidence - severity medium, not high.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) honor the documented posture: 'git rm -r --cached .sisyphus/evidence' keeping only the 2 negated files, or (b) keep the evidence versioned and amend both AGENTS.md files to state 'evidence/ is partially versioned: 71 historical artifacts tracked (pre-ignore-rule), new evidence ignored except MANIFEST.json and extensions-counter.json'. Option (b) preserves the stronger traceability posture.

fix_examples.before: .sisyphus/AGENTS.md:74: '- **evidence/ is gitignored** (`.gitignore` line: `.sisyphus/evidence/`). Verification artifacts live locally but are never committed.'
fix_examples.after: .sisyphus/AGENTS.md:74: '- **evidence/ is ignore-on-add**: `.gitignore:20` ignores new evidence, but 71 pre-rule artifacts remain tracked (task-121b..141, parity-audit, final-qa). Only MANIFEST.json and extensions-counter.json are explicitly un-ignored (.gitignore:22,43). Run `git ls-files .sisyphus/evidence` for the versioned set.'

findings.fix_guide: Decide posture; for (b) edit .sisyphus/AGENTS.md lines 45-46, 74-75 and the root AGENTS.md NOTES bullet ('evidence/ dir is gitignored'); for (a) run git rm -r --cached .sisyphus/evidence, re-add MANIFEST.json + extensions-counter.json, commit. Either way add a one-line note in .gitignore above line 19 explaining the tracked-file grandfathering.

effort_estimate.breakdown: posture decision 10min; AGENTS.md edits (option b) 10min or git rm --cached (option a) 10min; verification 10min

findings.title: Orchestration knowledge-base drift: AGENTS.md documents 10 decisions / 13 plans vs 26 / 15 on disk, and its 'current active plan' pointer contradicts boulder.json
findings.description: .sisyphus/AGENTS.md:26 says 'decisions/ (10 files)' and its structure tree lists exactly 10; the directory holds 26 git-tracked files - the 5 numbered DR records dr-016..dr-020 and 11 unnumbered records (accepted-debt-ethers-oauth2, buff-observe-deferred, cc-build-dep-exception, codegen-rust-god-functions-deferred, dyn-trait-extension, extern-rust-abi-deferred, libsqlite3-sys-exception, porting-conventions, ring-exception, selfhost-feasibility, deprecation-phase-b) are absent from the listing. Line 12 says 'plans/ (13 files)' - 15 exist (self-host-completion-roadmap.md, 53,789 bytes, and debt-zero-best-practices.md are missing from the tree). Line 56 says 'Current active plan: plans/v1.26-real-use-cases-launch.md' while .sisyphus/boulder.json:2 sets active_plan to self-host-completion-roadmap.md. Root AGENTS.md:55 repeats 'plans/ (13 files)' and its header pins commit bcbb711 / branch 'chore/iter30-local-ci-skip``main``' versus actual HEAD d5b2a23 on branch main (bcbb711 is an ancestor, so stale-not-wrong).
findings.root_cause: Both AGENTS.md files were last regenerated at the v1.39 milestone (root header: Generated 2026-07-27) while the self-host-completion roadmap wave (dr-016..dr-020, roadmap plan, 11 new ADRs) landed afterwards without a knowledge-base regeneration step in the workflow.
findings.impact: The mandatory first-read files (FP rule) misroute both humans and AI agents: an agent trusting the 10-file decision index concludes cited records dr-016..dr-020 and DR-014/DR-015 (under unnumbered names) are unresolvable; the wrong active-plan pointer sends execution to a superseded plan. This is precisely the class of false negative this audit's citation-integrity check is designed to catch.
findings.recommendation: Add a knowledge-base refresh step to the milestone checklist (same commit as the final docs pass): regenerate the .sisyphus/AGENTS.md structure tree and counts from Get-ChildItem, derive the 'Current active plan' line from boulder.json rather than hard-coding it, and refresh the root AGENTS.md header commit/branch and line 55 plan count. Count files programmatically at write time.

fix_examples.before: .sisyphus/AGENTS.md:26: 'decisions/                    # ADR-style decision records (10 files)' ; :56: '| Current active plan | `plans/v1.26-real-use-cases-launch.md` |'
fix_examples.after: .sisyphus/AGENTS.md:26: 'decisions/                    # ADR-style decision records (26 files: dr-016..dr-020 numbered + 21 topic-named)' ; :56: '| Current active plan | see `boulder.json:active_plan` (currently `plans/self-host-completion-roadmap.md`) |'

findings.fix_guide: Run: (Get-ChildItem .sisyphus/decisions -File).Count and (Get-ChildItem .sisyphus/plans -File).Count; replace hard-coded counts; expand the decisions tree listing with the 16 missing files; change the WHERE-TO-LOOK active-plan row to reference boulder.json dynamically; update root AGENTS.md:55 count and regenerate its header from git rev-parse --short HEAD + git branch --show-current.

effort_estimate.breakdown: recount + tree edits 20min; active-plan pointer + root AGENTS.md header 10min; cross-check boulder.json consistency 10min

findings.title: Fragile by-number resolution for DR-015 (single citation, no path) and DR-019 (one comment-line citation plus an implicit range); mapping for both relies solely on in-file self-labels under unnumbered/odd filenames
findings.description: DR citation set CITED = {DR-014, DR-015, DR-016, DR-017, DR-018, DR-020} plus the range 'DR-016 through DR-020' (p5_9:9) that implicitly covers DR-019. All resolve: dr-016..dr-020 are numbered, self-labeling files ('# DR-0XX: ...' H1, verified at each file's line 1), and .cargo/audit.toml:31 individually cites DR-019 ('Tracked in DR-019'). No cited-but-unresolvable DR exists. The fragility is asymmetric: DR-014 is cited 8+ times WITH explicit paths (self-host/README.md:41,62; docs/SELF_HOST_MIGRATION.md:8,24,115), whereas DR-015 (file: deprecation-phase-b.md) has exactly one by-number citation (p5_9:24, 'DR-015 + migration guide (PR #36)') with no path, and DR-019's only individual citation is a TOML comment; p5_9's own Formal Deferrals list (lines 72-76) enumerates DR-016/017/018/F4/DR-020 and omits DR-019 even though line 9's range claim includes it.
findings.root_cause: DR-015/DR-019 were retro-numbered onto topic-named or exception-file records during the compliance pass; citations were written where convenient (one narrative mention, one config comment) instead of in the deferral ledger that line 70-76 formalizes.
findings.impact: A reader auditing the compliance report's Formal Deferrals section finds no DR-015/DR-019 entries and may conclude the deprecation freeze and the accepted-risk on a persistently red cargo-audit workflow were informal choices; resolution currently depends on grepping for self-labels inside non-obviously-named files. Low severity because every citation does ultimately resolve and the records are git-tracked.
findings.recommendation: Extend the p5_9 Formal Deferrals list (or add a 'Related formal records' subsection) with explicit entries: 'DR-015: deprecation Phase B freeze (P5.10, PR #36) - .sisyphus/decisions/deprecation-phase-b.md' and 'DR-019: cargo-audit persistent-failure accepted risk - .sisyphus/decisions/dr-019-security-workflow-failure.md', mirroring the path-citing style already used for DR-014 in docs/SELF_HOST_MIGRATION.md:115. Optionally mirror the DR-019 pointer in .github/workflows/security.yml as a comment next to continue-on-error.
